rules.name: AntiLife
rules.blurb: The black/white reversal of Conway's Game of Life.

rules.name: InverseLife
rules.blurb: A rule by Jason Rampe, showing similar oscillators and gliders to Conway's Game of Life.

rules.name: Oils

rules.name: Invertamaze

rules.name: Neon Blobs
rules.blurb: A strobing rule in which patterns become neon-like explosive patterns.

rules.name: H-trees
rules.blurb: An exploding rule where H-shaped branches grow from pattern borders.

rules.name: Fuzz
rules.blurb: An exploding rule in which solid patterns appear.

rules.blurb: A simple exploding rule by Kellie Evans that forms complex patterns from even a single live cell.

rules.name: Snakeskin

rules.blurb: A rule in which, like Replicator, every pattern is a replicator.

rules.name: Feux
rules.blurb: An explosive rule where patterns turn into replicators and flash in and out of existence.

rules.name: Forrest of Ls
rules.blurb: An explosive rule where the insides of patterns slowy stablize into still formations.

rules.name: Seeds
rules.blurb: An exploding rule by Brian Silverman in which every cell dies in every generation.

rules.name: Live Free or Die
rules.blurb: An exploding rule in which only cells with no neighbors survive.

rules.name: Serviettes
rules.blurb: An exploding rule in which every cell dies in every generation (like Seeds).

rules.name: Iceballs
rules.blurb: Small masses of solid living cells flicker in and out of existence.

rules.blurb: An expanding rule that produces complex flakes, featuring dense wickstretchers named ladders.

rules.name: DotLife
rules.blurb: An exploding rule closely related to Conway's Life.

rules.name: Star Trek
rules.blurb: A rule with several spaceships of various speeds.

rules.name: Flock

rules.name: Corrosion of Conformity
rules.blurb: A rule similar to Mazectric but without S3.

rules.blurb: A chaotic rule that is by far the most well-known and well-studied.

rules.name: EightLife
rules.blurb: Also known as Pulsar Life.

rules.name: Coral
rules.blurb: An exploding rule in which patterns grow slowly and form coral-like textures.

rules.blurb: A stable rule that gets its name from the fact that it has many simple extremely high period oscillators.

rules.name: Gems Minor
rules.blurb: An exploding rule with many smaller high-period oscillators and a c/2068 spaceship.

rules.name: Eppstein
rules.blurb: An exploding rule explored by Dean Hickerson and David Eppstein.

rules.blurb: An explosive rule with many high density spaceships.

rules.blurb: A self-complementary rule.

rules.name: 2x2

rules.name: Land Rush 2
rules.blurb: An exploding rule that got confused with Land Rush, likely due to a typo.

rules.name: DrighLife
rules.blurb: A mix between DryLife and HighLife

rules.blurb: A rule where patterns almost explode into castle-like stable patterns.

rules.name: Stains

rules.name: Day & Night
rules.blurb: A stable rule that is symmetric under on-off reversal.

rules.blurb: Similar to Life without death, but patterns tend to grow quadratically instead of forming 'ladders'.

rules.name: Mazectric with Mice
rules.blurb: Some mice run back and forth in the halls of the maze.

rules.name: Maze with Mice
rules.blurb: Similar to B37/S1234, some mice run back and forth in the continually-stretching halls of the maze.

rules.name: Plow World

rules.name: Coagulations

rules.name: Pedestrian Flock

rules.name: HoneyLife
rules.blurb: A mix between Pedestrian Life and EightLife.

rules.name: Oscillators Rule

rules.name: Walled cities

rules.name: Vote 4/5

rules.name: Rings 'n' Slugs

rules.name: Vote
rules.blurb: Standard Gérard Vichniac voting rule, also known as Majority, used as a model for majority voting.

rules.name: Burst II

rules.name: Caterpillars

rules.name: Chenille
rules.blurb: Exploding.

rules.name: Faders

rules.name: Fireworks

rules.name: Flaming Starbows
rules.blurb: Rockafellor. Exploding. By Charles A.

rules.name: Frogs

rules.name: Lava

rules.name: Living On The Edge
rules.blurb: Also known as LOTE. Chaotic. By Mirek Wójtowicz.

rules.name: Meteor Guns
rules.blurb: Rockafellor. Expanding. By Charles A.

rules.name: Prairie on fire

rules.name: RainZha
rules.blurb: The simplest Zhabotinsky style cellular automaton. Exploding. By Rudy Rucker and John Walker.

rules.name: Snake
rules.blurb: This rule is a simple variation of the Worms rule. Exploding. By Brian Prentice.

rules.name: Soft Freeze

rules.name: Spirals
rules.blurb: The rule produces beautiful stable spirals that unroll forever. Exploding.

rules.name: Sticks

rules.name: Transers II
rules.blurb: Exploding. By Michael Sweney.

rules.blurb: expanding rule by David Griffeath

rules.blurb: semistable rule by H.

rules.blurb: chaotic rule by bubblegum; weighted neighbourhood, HROT only
